header.policy-title: Remote Work and Flexible Work Arrangement Policy

purpose.statement: This policy establishes guidelines and expectations for employees working remotely or under flexible work arrangements to ensure productivity, security, and well-being.

scope.statement: This policy applies to all full-time and part-time employees, contractors, and consultants who work remotely on a regular or occasional basis.
scope.exclusion: Temporary emergency remote work situations are handled under the Business Continuity Policy (POL-2024-BC-001).

definitions.term: Work performed at a location other than the primary office, including home, co-working spaces, or other approved locations.
A flexible arrangement where an employee splits their working time between an office and a remote location.
Designated time periods during which all employees must be available for collaboration, regardless of their work location.

clause.content: Employees must have completed a minimum of six months of employment before applying for a formal remote work arrangement. Performance must be rated as Meets Expectations or above in the most recent review cycle.
Not all roles are suitable for remote work. Managers must assess whether the nature of the role, team dependencies, and client requirements permit remote work.
clause.important: Customer-facing roles requiring physical presence are exempt from this policy by default.

clause.content: The company will provide a laptop and necessary peripherals for approved remote workers. Personal devices may not be used for work purposes without explicit approval from the IT Security team.
All remote work must be conducted over a secure, password-protected network. Employees must use the company VPN whenever accessing internal systems.
clause.critical-warning: Using public WiFi without VPN connection is a policy violation and may result in disciplinary action.

clause.content: The company reserves the right to monitor system access, network activity, and productivity metrics for employees working remotely, in accordance with applicable laws.
Violations of this policy may result in withdrawal of remote work privileges, formal disciplinary action, or termination of employment depending on severity.
